title: eval-harness: add CI prompt-regression checks, quality gating, and metrics integration
author: Maya Chen
description: Motivation: prevent prompt-set regressions and automate quality gating by surfacing eval metrics in CI. This PR adds a lightweight CI hook that computes per-prompt and aggregate eval metrics, compares them against configured baselines/thresholds, and fails the pipeline if quality gates are violated. Changes: 1) CI hook implementation and runner (eval-harness/ci/hooks/prompt_regression_check.py) 2) metrics exporter that formats eval outputs for CI (eval-harness/metrics/ci_integration.py) 3) GitHub Actions workflow to run prompt regression checks on PRs and nightly runs (ci/workflows/eval-harness.yml) 4) default quality gate thresholds and configuration (eval-harness/config/quality_gates.yaml) 5) unit tests and integration test harness (tests/eval_harness/test_regression_checks.py, tests/ci/test_workflow_integration.py) 6) docs and developer guide for adding new prompt-sets (docs/eval-harness/quality-gates.md). Compatibility: runs on hosted CI and self-hosted runners; non-blocking mode available for experiments. Rollout: feature is behind a repo-level toggle and defaults to enabled for eval-harness-owned changes. See linked Linear tickets for rollout plan and followups.

release_notes: Adds CI prompt-regression checks and quality gating for eval-harness. New GitHub Actions workflow to compute eval metrics and fail PRs on regression by default; configurable thresholds and non-blocking mode available. Includes docs and tests.
notes: CI initially failed due to flaky integration test; fixed by forcing deterministic seed in test harness and adding a small retry for transient network fetches. Nightly job configured to run heavy evals and refresh baselines when requested.
